name: Google Chrome / Chromium: command line, headless, DevTools Protocol and automation
requested: google-chrome CLI docs plus docs on controlling Chrome from the command line and/or an API (latest stable; no version given)
summary: Controlling Chrome 158 (158.0.8127.88) from outside: every command-line switch (--remote-debugging-port, --headless, --user-data-dir, --dump-dom, --screenshot, --print-to-pdf, --no-sandbox, --proxy-server, ...) generated from the Chromium source; the full Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) reference for this release (59 domains, 677 commands, 232 events) and its HTTP /json endpoints; Headless mode and chrome-headless-shell; ChromeDriver (WebDriver, capabilities, goog:chromeOptions); Chrome for Testing and its JSON download API; WebDriver BiDi; Chrome DevTools for agents (chrome-devtools-mcp 1.14.0 MCP server and chrome-devtools CLI).
license: BSD-3-Clause (Chromium source, switch comments, PDL protocol definitions); CC-BY-4.0 text with Apache-2.0 code samples (developer.chrome.com); Apache-2.0 (chrome-devtools-mcp, chrome-for-testing, debugger-protocol-viewer)

sources.path: include/js_protocol.pdl (unchanged; Runtime, Debugger, Profiler, HeapProfiler, Console, Schema domains)
CDP reference pages generated from api/pdl by tools/pdl2md.py

55 pages as <page>.md.txt: docs/automation-and-testing/*, docs/chromedriver/*, docs/chromium/headless, docs/devtools/agents/*, docs/devtools/protocol-monitor, docs/devtools/remote-debugging*, docs/puppeteer, and blog posts on headless, Chrome for Testing, remote-debugging-port, WebDriver BiDi, chrome-devtools-mcp

coverage: All 1,258 command-line switches defined in 97 desktop *_switches files at the 158.0.8127.88 tag, one page per source file plus an A-Z index (01-command-line-switches/ALL-SWITCHES.md); the complete CDP for this exact release (browser_protocol.pdl + V8 js_protocol.pdl: 59 domains, 677 commands, 232 events, all types) as raw PDL and one Markdown page per domain; the CDP site's overview (HTTP endpoints /json/version, /json/list, /json/new, /json/protocol, WebSocket URLs, --remote-allow-origins); Chromium's headless, ChromeDriver, Chrome for Testing, user-data-dir and headless-GPU docs at the tag; the developer.chrome.com automation-and-testing, Headless, ChromeDriver and DevTools-for-agents docs; Chrome for Testing JSON endpoints; chrome-devtools-mcp 1.14.0 docs (tool reference, CLI, configuration).
gaps: Chrome has no official, human-written list of command-line switches. 01-command-line-switches is generated from the source comments, so many switches are terse or undocumented, and many are developer/test-only or have no effect in branded Google Chrome. Switches defined outside *_switches.{h,cc} files, and base::Feature names used with --enable-features/--disable-features, are not listed.
Switch files for ChromeOS/Ash, Android WebView, Chromecast, Fuchsia and iOS, and test-only switch files, were left out (desktop Chrome only).

developer.chrome.com, the chrome-for-testing README and the debugger-protocol-viewer overview are not versioned: they are snapshots taken 2026-11-28 (the CfT README and viewer at main/master, not a tag). ChromeDriver/CfT pages describe the current state, which may mention later milestones.

The CDP reference pages are generated from PDL by tools/pdl2md.py, not taken from chromedevtools.github.io (whose per-domain pages are built in the browser). The devtools-protocol npm/JSON package has no build exactly at this release (nearest r1724436 before the branch point), so the PDL from the release tag was used instead.

No official 'Chrome 158 release notes' page exists on developer.chrome.com at ingest time; only the 'Chrome 158 beta' post is included. Chrome Status release notes (chromestatus.com) and 'What's new in DevTools' posts are not included.
Chrome Enterprise policies (chrome://policy, the policy list) are not included.

The W3C WebDriver and WebDriver BiDi specifications themselves are not included; only Chrome's blog posts about BiDi. Puppeteer is a separate set (libraries/puppeteer/25.19.0, which pins Chrome 158.0.8127.88); Playwright is libraries/playwright/1.65.0.
Images, author bios and site components on developer.chrome.com pages are left as-is or missing; chrome-devtools-mcp's skills/ folder (agent skill files) was not included.
This machine has Google Chrome 151.0.7922.71 installed (google-chrome --version), older than this set; switch and CDP details may differ for 151.
notes: Version: Chrome for Testing last-known-good Stable on 2026-11-28 was 158.0.8127.88 (Chromium revision/branch position 1727472); chrome/VERSION at the tag confirms 158.0.8127.88. Switches: modern Chromium declares many switches as inline constexpr in headers rather than .cc files, so both were parsed and merged by constant name, keeping comments from either side and the #if condition (platform/buildflag) each switch sits under; a switch defined in several components appears once per file. CDP: browser_protocol.pdl includes domains/*.pdl; js_protocol.pdl was taken from V8 at the v8_revision pinned by the tag's DEPS. Pages fetched from developer.chrome.com as .md.txt had no title, so a '# Title' (from llms.txt) and 'Source: <url>' line were prepended; otherwise unchanged. third_party/blink/public/devtools_protocol/AGENTS.md (Chromium contributor guidance for AI coding agents) was deliberately not copied. No build-time placeholders found. Tools added for this set: tools/switches2md.py, tools/pdl2md.py.
